import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;
import java.math.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long x = sc.nextLong();
        long y = sc.nextLong();
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        
        double min_ = Double.MAX_VALUE;
        long ans_a = 0;
        long ans_b = 1;
        
        for (long i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            long a = x * i / y;
            double diff1 = Math.abs((double)x / y - (double)a / i);
            if (diff1 < min_) {
                min_ = diff1;
                ans_a = a;
                ans_b = i;
            }
            a++;
            double diff2 = Math.abs((double)x / y - (double)a / i);
            if (diff2 < min_) {
                min_ = diff2;
                ans_a = a;
                ans_b = i;
            }
        }
        
        System.out.println(ans_a + "/" + ans_b);
    }
}
